privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: This Privacy policy explains which personal data we process, for what purpose, and what rights you have. This text is a baseline template and must be reviewed by a lawyer to match the legislation of your country.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
body: The data controller is the operator of the plant store (the sole trader / legal entity listed under "Contacts" and in the Terms of use).
For questions about personal data processing, please use the contacts listed on the "Contacts" page.

sections.heading: 2. What data we process
body: Profile data: first name, last name, patronymic, phone, email, delivery address.
Order data: order contents, delivery method and address, payment method, status history.

Technical data: cookies and optional analytics or marketing/advertising technologies (only after consent). This may include device/browser information, page interactions and consent state. We do not send name, email, phone or address via Tag Manager / dataLayer.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose and legal basis
body: Customer data is processed to place and fulfil orders and to communicate about delivery and support — based on contract performance and user consent.

Optional analytics and marketing/advertising technologies are used only with separate consent. We use Google Tag Manager to manage approved tags; Google Analytics 4 and Google Ads are not currently active. You can change or withdraw consent on the Cookie policy page.

sections.heading: 4. Who receives the data
body: Data may be shared with delivery carriers, payment providers and email/SMS notification providers — only to the extent needed to fulfil an order.
We do not sell personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: 5. Retention period
body: Profile data is kept while the account is active. Order data is kept for the period required for accounting and tax records.
You can delete your account at any time from account settings — see the section below.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
body: You have the right to access, correct, delete (anonymize), restrict, and object to the processing of your data.
You can download a copy of your data or delete your account from your dashboard, under "Settings" → "Data & privacy".

cookiesPage.title: Cookie policy
cookiesPage.intro: This page explains which cookies the site uses, for what purpose, and how to manage your consent.

sections.heading: What are cookies
body: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit the site. They help it work correctly and remember your preferences.

sections.heading: How we use cookies
body: Necessary cookies power core functions such as the cart, sign-in/session, language and storing your cookie choice. This category cannot be switched off.
Analytics cookies/technologies are optional (currently including Vercel Analytics). They run only after Analytics consent. Google Analytics 4 is not currently active.

Marketing cookies/technologies are optional and may support advertising or conversion measurement when enabled. They run only after Marketing consent. Google Ads is not currently implemented or collecting data.
Google Tag Manager is used as a tag-management tool; it is not itself an advertising service.

sections.heading: Your choice
body: Before you choose, Analytics and Marketing stay off. You can accept all, keep Necessary only, or customise Analytics and Marketing independently.
You can change your choice at any time below on this page. The consent preference cookie (ga-cookie-consent) lasts about 180 days unless you change it.

shippingPage.costsBody3: If additional charges apply to a particular delivery or payment method, they will be shown at checkout before the order is confirmed.
shippingPage.deliveryTimeBody: The estimated delivery time is usually 2–8 days from the date the order is placed. The actual delivery time depends on the destination country, selected delivery method and current availability of the ordered plants.
shippingPage.dispatchDateBody1: If this option is available for your order, you can select the date on which your order will be dispatched from our nursery during checkout.
shippingPage.dispatchDateBody2: The selected date is the dispatch date, not a guaranteed delivery date. Delivery time after dispatch depends on the carrier and destination country.
shippingPage.paymentIntro: Available payment methods are shown according to the delivery country and selected delivery method.
shippingPage.codFeeFixed: Any cash-on-delivery fee: {amount}. It is also shown at checkout before you place the order.
shippingPage.livePlantsBody1: Plants are living products and safe transport requires appropriate packaging. We adapt the packaging to the type, size and current condition of each plant.
shippingPage.livePlantsBody2: For this reason, available delivery options may differ between orders. Checkout always shows the options currently available for the particular order.
shippingPage.damageBody1: We recommend checking the parcel when you receive it. If the packaging is visibly damaged, we recommend documenting the damage and, where possible, recording it with the carrier.
shippingPage.damageBody2: If a plant or other contents of the parcel were damaged during transport, please contact us as soon as possible and include photographs of the damage and packaging.
shippingPage.damageBody3: Details about complaints and returns are available in our General Terms and Conditions and on the Returns and withdrawal page.
shippingPage.helpBody: If you have a question about delivery, payment or an existing order, please contact us using the details on our Contact page.

sections.heading: 1. General
body: These Terms govern the relationship between {sellerName} (“Seller”) and customers of the online shop (“Site”).
By placing an order you confirm that you accept these Terms.

sections.heading: 2. Ordering
body: Orders may be placed via the Site, phone, or email.
After ordering we send a confirmation to your email.
The Seller may refuse an order if goods are unavailable or the customer cannot be contacted.

sections.heading: 3. Prices and payment
body: Prices are shown in Ukrainian hryvnia and include VAT unless stated otherwise.
Prices may change without notice; the order price is fixed when placed.
Available payment methods are shown at checkout (e.g. card online, bank transfer).

sections.heading: 4. Delivery
body: Delivery uses methods available in the cart (e.g. Nova Poshta or pickup — depending on store settings).
Timing depends on the method and region.
Delivery cost follows carrier tariffs and depends on weight and size.

sections.heading: 5. Returns
body: You may return unused goods of satisfactory quality within 14 days of receipt, subject to rules for live plants.
Plant returns are accepted primarily for transport damage or variety mismatch; claims within 24 hours with photos.
Return shipping is paid by the buyer except for defective goods.

sections.heading: 6. Warranty
body: The Seller warrants planting material quality at sale.
Warranty excludes post-delivery damage from improper care, weather, or mechanical damage.

sections.heading: 7. Privacy
body: Personal data is processed under the Privacy Policy and applicable Ukrainian law.
Data is used to fulfil orders and communicate; shared with third parties only as needed for delivery, payment, or accounting.
